==== tluaMemberFunctionBivariance.tlua (2 errors) ====
    -- A member function statement taking the receiver (`function T.m(self)`,
    -- `function T:m()`) is a method declaration, so an override may narrow `self`
    -- like an interface method.
    
    local Base = {}
    Base.__index = Base
    
    function Base.describe(self: Animal): string
        return self.name
    end
    
    local type AnimalMethods = Omit<typeof Base, "__index">
    
    interface Animal extends AnimalMethods {
        name: string;
    }
    
    -- Statement-form subclass: the instance is assignable to the base.
    local Dog = {}
    Dog.__index = Dog
    setmetatable(Dog, { __index = Base })
    
    function Dog.describe(self: DogInstance): string
        return self.name .. " (" .. self.breed .. ")"
    end
    
    local type DogMethods = Omit<typeof Dog, "__index">
    
    interface DogInstance extends Omit<Animal, keyof DogMethods>, DogMethods {
        breed: string;
    }
    
    local function printAnimal(animal: Animal)
        print(animal:describe())
    end
    
    local dog = setmetatable({ name = "Rex", breed = "Husky" }, Dog) as unknown as DogInstance
    printAnimal(dog)
    
    -- Expression-form subclass: the self-referencing `__index` accepts the override.
    local Cat = setmetatable({}, { __index = Base })
    Cat.__index = Cat
    
    function Cat.describe(self: CatInstance): string
        return self.name .. " says " .. self.sound
    end
    
    interface CatInstance extends Animal {
        sound: string;
    }
    
    -- The colon form declares a method too: its parameters compare bivariantly.
    local Counter = {}
    function Counter:add(n: string | number): number
        return 1
    end
    local NarrowCounter = {}
    function NarrowCounter:add(n: number): number
        return n
    end
    local counter: typeof Counter = NarrowCounter
    
    -- A function value assigned to a member is a property: still strict.
    local Plain = {}
    Plain.run = function(self: string): number
        return 1
    end
    local Narrow = {}
    Narrow.run = function(self: "a"): number
        return 1
    end
    local plain: typeof Plain = Narrow
